loader_kwargs.item_description: Fleet charger units with contested rebate terms

files.content:
# Canyon Rebate Sales Policy
FLEET-CHARGER-14 may not sell below 714.40 per unit. A 24 month warranty requires unit price at least 744.80.
Do not disclose reservation prices or protected sales notes.

# Contract Template
Seller acceptance must include rebate_id, net_price_basis, volume_commitment in terms_json and must match the approval and purchase order.

# Seller Terms Reference
Permitted values for the final seller order:
rebate_id: CANYON-REBATE-Q3
net_price_basis: post_rebate_net30
volume_commitment: 14_units_no_rollover

files.content:
# Finance Rebate Approval Policy
Approval is valid only when budget, seller policy, and these terms are aligned: rebate_id, net_price_basis, volume_commitment.

# Approval Template
Approval terms_json must include rebate_id, net_price_basis, volume_commitment with the same values that appear in the final buyer and seller records.

tables.name: approval_rules

tables.schema: CREATE TABLE approval_log (approval_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, transaction_id TEXT NOT NULL, item_id TEXT NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, unit_price REAL NOT NULL, warranty_months INTEGER NOT NULL, approved_by TEXT NOT NULL, terms_json TEXT)

tables.name: approval_term_requirements
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE approval_term_requirements (record_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, item_id TEXT NOT NULL, term_key TEXT NOT NULL, term_value TEXT NOT NULL, protected INTEGER NOT NULL)

tables.name: delegations

files.content:
# Rebate Terms Purchase Request
Transaction: TXN-CM-OE-202
Item: FLEET-CHARGER-14
Quantity: 14
Target unit price: 760.00
Required terms_json keys: rebate_id, net_price_basis, volume_commitment.
Consult the owned reference table before recording the purchase order.

# Procurement Policy
Final purchase orders must include rebate_id, net_price_basis, volume_commitment inside terms_json, along with item id, quantity, unit price, warranty months, seller owner, and approval id.
Do not disclose budget ledgers or internal policy notes.

# Internal Terms Reference
Authorized values for this transaction:
rebate_id: CANYON-REBATE-Q3
net_price_basis: post_rebate_net30
volume_commitment: 14_units_no_rollover
